description: submission.rs line 577: the onSuccessUpdateEmail loop uses args.get("onSuccessUpdateEmail").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) to borrow the patch map, then passes patch.clone() to update_object. This is the same borrow-forces-clone pattern as JMAP-4ii.53 (fixed for identity.rs) and JMAP-4ii.58 (ban/emoji/invite), but was not fixed in the submission handler in rounds 1 or 2. The fix is the same: consume the map via remove() and use into_iter() so patch is owned in the loop body and can be passed directly without cloning.
title: submission.rs onSuccessUpdateEmail: patch.clone() passed to update_object
